display_information.name: Kudos Bot
display_information.description: Type /compliment and Kudos Bot posts a random compliment for the whole channel.
display_information.long_description: Kudos Bot is a tiny morale booster for your team. Anyone in a channel can type /compliment and the app instantly posts a random, work-friendly compliment that everyone in the channel can see. This variant follows the course guide: it posts with chat.postMessage using the chat:write bot scope (commands is added automatically by Slack for the slash command). It never reads messages.

slash_commands.description: Post a random compliment to the channel
